work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCXXIV to Bishop-elect Nicolau Rodrigues Pereira de Borja of Macao praises his refusal to administer the see before institution and binds him to the decrees on the vicariates; address, intitulation, greeting, body, blessing and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF40050–40050; the source dating clause at LF40146–40149 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die octava iulii mil- lesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno decimo tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
